plainText:
Volume 28: The Stolen Wishing Star is the 28th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the third of four volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
Ruby and Sapphire are back! Professor Birch sends the fabulous duo to help Emerald find the Wish Pokémon Jirachi. But first there are high-pitched Pokémon battles to fight in the Battle Dome Tournament... Then Ruby discovers something surprising about Emerald's Sceptile, and everyone learns the true identity of their arch nemesis, Guile Hideout.

Now, who will catch Jirachi...?

==Important events==
 
The Frontier Brains learn how Guile Hideout's sword works.
It is revealed that can only grant wishes of the people who have seen its third eye.
Wanda and Riley get married.

Emerald declines the help offered by Ruby and Sapphire.
Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald challenge the Battle Dome.
Emerald's Sceptile is revealed to have lost all the memories of its time before evolving into Sceptile.
Noland devises a plan to find Jirachi.
Guile Hideout captures Jirachi and leaves it to complete his wish.
Anabel is revealed to be under Guile's mind control.
The statue of , , , , and is revealed to have been placed in the .
Guile Hideout is revealed to be Archie, Team Aqua's leader.
